fit: pumpkin oil-enriched diet and seated blood pressure measurement in hyperlipidemia
assessment: The registry specifies seated pressure after rest. The published abstract omits arm-specific values, and the verified four-page supplement reports fatty-acid laboratory results only. Main clinical tables, processing grade and standing symptoms remain unverified.

fit: bedtime dried parsley tea comparator and morning refreshment
assessment: Forty-one healthy adults took each tea over seven nights, with a one-week washout. Table 1 gives morning refreshment means of 3.37 after parsley and 3.49 after passionflower. The crossover used an active comparison and left daytime sleepiness unmeasured.

fit: same Khalid case of celery root extract with concurrent antidepressant exposures
assessment: The original abstract confirms mania and elevated venlafaxine after adding celery root extract during concurrent venlafaxine and St Johns wort use. A subsequent review reports hallucinations without modality. Visual specificity, dose and frequency remain unverified against the inaccessible original body.

fit: standardized ginger tablets and constipation visual analogue scales in relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis
assessment: VAS severity changed −24.15 versus +11.39 and patient-rated frequency −23.63 versus +14.81 at 12 weeks, both adjusted p<.001. The frequency score is not an observed stool count. The baseline imbalance, standardized tablet and multiple sclerosis population limit transfer.
